 Sk,J
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice K.Sarath
 Writ Petition No.9562 Of 2016
Order:

1. This Writ Petition is filed questioning the action of the respondents in demolishing the house bearing No.17-13 to 15, admeasuring to an extent of 64.88 Sq.Yards, situated at Jammikunta Road,
Huzurabad Village and Mandal, Karimnagar District, without issuing any notice or without initiating any proceedings under Land Acquisition Act and without paying any compensation.
2. Heard the learned Counsel for the petitioners and the learned Assistant Government Pleader for Roads and Buildings appearing for the respondents.

3. As per the counter filed by the respondent No.3, the respondent authorities are not interfering with the possession of the petitoiner over the subject property, and only to ascertain how much structures are SK,J affecting in widening the road from 80' to 100' the marking was given.

4. In view of the submission made by the learned Assistant Govermnet Pleader for Roads and Buildings, this Writ Petition is disposed of directing the respondents not to interfere with the possession of the petitioner over the subject property, without following due process of law.

If the respondents wants to acquire the land of the petitioner, they have to follow the procedure as contemplated under Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
